title: Canadian poet and essayist Anne Carson awarded Nobel Prize in Literature

image.caption: Anne Carson is shown at the 75th National Book Awards in New York City on Nov. 20, 2024. (Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Images)

blocks.text: The Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded Thursday to Canadian poet and librettist Anne Carson for her "bold and inventive oeuvre."
Carson, 76, has previously won several prestigious literary prizes
The Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded Thursday to Canadian poet and librettist Anne Carson by the Swedish Academy in Stockholm for her "bold and inventive oeuvre."
